_source: ADR 7.3.2.1 — special provisions concerning carriage in bulk containers (API field: specProvBulk, Table A column 10)

bk_codes.BK1: Carriage in bulk permitted in sheeted bulk containers.
bk_codes.BK2: Carriage in bulk permitted in closed bulk containers.
bk_codes.BK3: Carriage in bulk permitted in flexible bulk containers.

_note: These are the three basic bulk-container codes; Chapter 7.3.3 additionally contains detailed special provisions VV/AP for specific substances carried in bulk — not reproduced here (outside the scope of the sample source record, in which the specProvBulk field was empty).
